description:
## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced during the post-relay routing on Ariadne distribution + MCP findings. PRINCIPAL observation: "At the least, we need to create a set of stoa agents that understand ariadne and railway well." Railway-access discipline exists at user-tier (`~/.claude/skills/railway-access/SKILL.md`) — canonical pattern for: read `op://Private/RAILWAY_API_TOKEN/credential` once per shell session, export to `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN`, batch all railway CLI calls in that session, unset at close.

Currently this is user-tier-only. Stoa-deployed projects don't inherit it unless PRINCIPAL has manually deployed equivalent content. New Stoa-team projects spinning up with a Railway deployment don't have substrate-canonical guidance for how their CAPTAINs interact with Railway.

## The substrate-tier skill

Mirror the user-tier `railway-access` skill to substrate-tier at `substrate/skills/railway-access/SKILL.md`. Content:

- The auth pattern (1Password CLI `op read` once, export `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN`)
- The anti-pattern (per-command `op read` triggers biometric prompts)
- Common operations cheatsheet (status, SSH, env vars, logs, deploys)
- The non-interactive SSH pattern
- Gotchas (`RAILWAY_API_TOKEN` vs `RAILWAY_TOKEN`, project-link state)
- Cross-ref to `1password-secrets` skill for the broader pattern

The substrate version is a deployment-target adaptation: `install.sh` deploys it to every Stoa-team project that has a Railway dependency. Project-specific config (which Railway project, which service) is per-project; the discipline is universal.

## Substrate touch-points

- `substrate/skills/railway-access/SKILL.md` — new file
- `substrate/install.sh` SKILL_NAMES — add `railway-access` to deploy list (per stoa--14u smoke-beat discipline; verify install.sh dry-run lists the new skill at every target)
- Cross-ref from `substrate/CAPTAIN_ADA.md` — ADA is the primary consumer (deploys + infrastructure ops)
- Possibly cross-ref from other CAPTAIN role files that may need Railway access (VERA verifying deployed service state; BARTLEBY recon against deployed file system)

## Gauntlet

ADA + CATO eyeball. Skill copy + install.sh wiring + minimal role-file cross-refs. ~50-80 LOC.

## Sequencing

P2. Substrate-canon gap; PRINCIPAL named explicit need. Arc 25+ candidate.

## Cross-references

- stoa--0tr — Ariadne substrate-tier onboarding canon (parallel substrate-tier skill for the Ariadne integration)
- stoa--14u — substrate-edit smoke-beat discipline (Arc 23, closed) — apply to install.sh wiring for this new skill
- User-tier source: `~/.claude/skills/railway-access/SKILL.md`
